body:
In 2008, Musk laid out the logic behind a $109,000 Roadster: start with a premium car, reinvest in the technology, then work toward models more people could afford.

That’s what makes this worth revisiting. When the long-term goal feels impossibly far away, a concrete next step gives you something to build—and a reason to keep going.
